rationale: Closed-form sub-phase LANDING — B17 PATH-B (framework-validated carry-forward + re-bank). Stage 2 charter § 4.3 step 2.7 explicitly framed B17 as PATH-A (rework per-target runners here + produce first real per-target kill-rate baseline) vs PATH-B (carry the framework-validated baseline forward + re-bank). PATH-B chosen on two grounds: (a) the existing mutmut-config.toml targets are testkit/integrity infrastructure (capture, code_verification_mms, golden, determinism, equivalence, property, cat4_draft_time) — none target the new closed-form sim packages, so producing real numbers against the current target set yields no closed-form-specific signal; meaningful B17 work for this sub-phase would have to ADD per-sim targets (strange_attractors, mandelbulb_explorer) AND rework the runner harness for uv-workspace member-import resolution, both of which are precisely the infrastructure B17 names. (b) Per the closed-form sub-phase charter § 9 R4 + § 11.2, B17's recommended owner (per Phase 1 audit § 13) is the continuous-CA implementation sub-phase, where RD-2D is the most GREEN target in the workspace and the runner-rework effort is amortized over a sim that has been GREEN since Phase 0. Closed-form ships only two sims and would amortize the same rework against a smaller benefit. The mutation-score gate remains advisory at this sub-phase (no HARD_FAIL). B17 re-banked to the next per-sim implementation sub-phase (agent-based pair: boids-3d + physarum), unless the operator re-routes ownership at dispatch time to continuous-CA per Phase 1 audit § 13's recommendation. Closed-form sub-phase Cat 3 (golden-values) DID go live this stage (commit chore(closed-form-stage2-cat3-recurse)); B17 (mutation) remains framework-validated.
